# Assessment Supplementary Facts

This directory contains supplemental assessment documents generated for the LinuxBanking application.

## Available Documents

- [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) — Two-layer architecture and component relationship diagrams for the frontend application.
- [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) — Declared npm dependencies grouped by functional category, including modernization risks.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) — Client route inventory, external API usage, and communication patterns.
- [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) — Persistence, transient state, data sensitivity, and model observations.
- [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, scripts, runtime settings, and version inventory.
- [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) — Primary user workflows and business rules implemented in the UI.
